text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"5 hanging baskets"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3 petunias"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2 sweet potato vines"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"petunias cost $3.00 apiece"},{"id":"q5","value":2.5,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"sweet potato vines cost $2.50 apiece"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply baskets (5) by petunias per basket (3) to find total petunias needed"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply total petunias by cost per petunia ($3.00) to find total petunia cost"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"multiply baskets (5) by vines per basket (2) to find total vines needed"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"multiply total vines by cost per vine ($2.50) to find total vine cost"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"add petunia cost and vine cost together for the total amount spent"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"total amount Katherine spends filling all 5 hanging baskets"},"dismissed":[]}
